• How many parts of the Listening paper have only one speaker?
• What should you do if you can’t hear the audio?

Make a copy of the parts of the booklet you want learners to look at. A fun option that also saves
paper, is to create a treasure hunt and cut the booklet into different sections and stick these around the
classroom so learners have to walk around to search for the answers.

Step 1

Hand out the worksheet with your questions on it and give learners time to read and think about what
kind of information they need to look for.

Step 2

Set a time limit or make the activity a competition so that it encourages learners to read quickly.
Start the activity.

When the time is up, you could get learners to write the answers on the board and check them together.
